name: Navi Subs
description: Arabic subtitles from Mirai Anime, best match first. SubDL and SubSource join in when you add your own key.

maxFiles.description: Most subtitle files to give for one episode

fonts.description: Give the subtitles a built-in Arabic font in place of their own. Turn it off if your device already has the fonts they use

release.description: Prefer subtitles timed for this kind of release

hideOtherSeasons.description: Leave out subtitles that belong to another season or part

subdlKey.description: Your own SubDL key (subdl.com/panel/api). Leave empty to skip SubDL

subsourceKey.description: Your own SubSource key (subsource.net, My Profile). Leave empty to skip SubSource
